resolutions.end_name: Lowman Energy Center, near Leroy, Washington County, Alabama
resolutions.researcher_notes: Traced from the route map on the Lowman Pipeline project page, as saved by the Internet Archive on July 13, 2023. The map shows the line in blue from near the Mississippi state line in Choctaw County, where it joins existing gas pipelines, southeast to the Lowman Energy Center on the Tombigbee River near Leroy in Washington County. The trace follows the middle of the blue line and ends at the plant dot. Five control points from US Census 2023 county boundaries were used: two Choctaw County corners, the point where Choctaw, Washington and Clarke counties meet, where the Choctaw and Washington county line meets the state line, and where the Washington County south line meets the river. The fit error is about 0.2 km. The map is small, so the line is good to roughly 1 to 2 km. The traced line is about 81 km against 54 miles, about 87 km, on the sheet; the trace smooths small bends. The plant end is within about 0.5 km of the plant location in the federal power plant records. The Alabama Public Service Commission notice in docket 32978 describes about 51 miles of 16 inch pipe from near Butler in Choctaw County to the Lowman Energy Center near Leroy in Washington County.
